purpose: Identify media sources that may be used without an individual permission request for RC3 development candidates.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.license_requirement: Object must expose an Open Access public-domain image; API metadata is CC0.
limitations: Art provenance does not prove that every depicted subject is an adult.
Metadata cannot by itself exclude explicit activity or child-safety conflicts.
Every downloaded object must retain its object ID, source URL, media URL, public-domain flag and hashes.

sources.name: Art Institute of Chicago Open Access
media_scope: public-domain artwork images exposed through IIIF
sources.license_requirement: The artwork record must set is_public_domain=true and provide an image_id.
limitations: The IIIF service also contains non-public-domain images, so the public-domain record flag is mandatory.
Descriptions are not uniformly CC0 and must not be imported as training text.
Requests must be throttled and performed sequentially.

sources.name: National Gallery of Art Open Access
sources.license_requirement: The image and collection record must be released through the NGA Open Access program.
limitations: Only records explicitly covered by Open Access are eligible.
Art provenance is not an age, consent or activity determination.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.license_requirement: The individual media record must carry the CC0 designation.
sources.api_key_required: public API normally uses an api.data.gov key; keyless official exports may be used instead
limitations: CC0 covers copyright, but third-party privacy, publicity or other rights may remain.
Items described only as no-known-copyright are excluded from automatic import.
Any API-key workflow is disabled by default for this project.

sources.name: Library of Congress Public Domain Films from the National Film Registry
sources.license_requirement: The exact film item must be in the Library's public-domain Free to Use and Reuse selection and its item rights statement must permit reuse.
limitations: Film Registry membership alone does not mean public domain.
Privacy, publicity, donation and international rights may still require assessment.
Only the specifically curated public-domain selection is eligible for automatic collection.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons general catalog
reasons: Licenses and attribution/share-alike requirements vary per file.
Wikimedia does not warrant the copyright status of each upload.
Privacy, personality, moral and publicity rights can remain.
Individual files may be considered only after manual rights verification.

sources.name: Openverse general search results
reasons: Search metadata is not sufficient proof of copyright, model releases, adulthood or consent.
Earlier unauthenticated collection attempts were incomplete and source availability was unstable.

sources.name: Public web pornography, celebrity-scene sites, movie screenshots and adult-site watermarked media
reasons: Copyright and redistribution rights are absent or unclear.
Adult status, consent, model releases and privacy rights cannot be established from pixels or filenames.
These materials must not enter training, calibration, RAG or independent evaluation.

sources.name: User-supplied examples in this development conversation
reasons: Ownership and redistribution rights were not established.
They may define abstract policy boundaries and aggregate diagnostics only.
They must not be copied into the repository, trained on, calibrated on or placed in an independent holdout.

unresolved_data_gaps.reason: No sufficiently diverse source with both reusable media rights and reliable adult/model-release evidence has been approved.
No permission-free source with adequate copyright, adulthood, consent, privacy and redistribution evidence has been approved.
Modern screen-media frames are normally copyrighted; title metadata does not grant reuse rights.

next_required_action: Collect only eligible candidates with full provenance, then complete human rights and boundary review before assigning dataset roles.
